notes: *Sing praises* is one unit on `זַמְּרוּ`: the supplied noun carries the verb's own lexeme and joins its single rendering under rule 44, headed on the verb.
The `לֵאלֹהֵינוּ` unit stands after the harp phrase, which the ASV has reordered; the discontinuity is rule 25's and does not break the unit.
